bnd-t2.label: DC share of runs from boundaries, 2024–2026
bnd-t2.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bnd-t2.filters: Fours and sixes off the bat ÷ all runs
bnd-t2.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) AND d.is_boundary = 1 THEN d.batter_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) THEN d.total_runs ELSE 0 END) team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN d.batter_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(d.total_runs) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) THEN d.total_runs ELSE 0 END) teamRuns FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY year HAVING teamRuns > 0 ORDER BY year

bnd-wlow.label: IPL win rate for innings with under 55% of runs from boundaries
bnd-wlow.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bnd-wlow.query: WITH inn AS (SELECT i.innings_id, i.batting_team_id bt, i.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN d.batter_runs ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.total_runs), 0) share FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY i.innings_id) SELECT CASE WHEN share < 0.55 THEN 'under 55%' WHEN share < 0.65 THEN '55–65%' ELSE '65% or more' END band, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = inn.bt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, SUM(CASE WHEN inn.bt IN (8,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn, SUM(CASE WHEN inn.bt IN (8,11) AND m.winner_id = inn.bt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tw FROM inn JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = inn.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY band
